interactionModel.notes: This is the interaction model for the Ask ABUZ8 voice experience, written in the Alexa interaction-model format. In this repository it drives the rule-based NLU of the simulated Alexa+ web experience (simulator/index.html). The same intents map 1:1 onto the MCP tools exposed by mcp_server/server.py, which is the surface Alexa+ connects to. The {payload_hash} argument of a decision is never typed by the user: the concierge presents the approval (with its hash) and the decision call carries that exact hash back, which is what makes the decision hash-bound.
